import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 5005;
    static final long inf = 1000000007L;

    static class Edge {
        int from, to, cap, flow, cost;
        Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d, int e) {
            from = a; to = b; cap = c; flow = d; cost = e;
        }
    }

    static class MCMF {
        int n, m;
        List<Edge> e;
        List<Integer>[] g;
        int[] inq;
        int[] d;
        int[] p;
        int[] a;

        MCMF(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            g = new List[n + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            e = new ArrayList<>();
            inq = new int[n + 1];
            d = new int[n + 1];
            p = new int[n + 1];
            a = new int[n + 1];
        }

        void init(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) g[i].clear();
            e.clear();
        }

        void add(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
            e.add(new Edge(from, to, cap, 0, cost));
            e.add(new Edge(to, from, 0, 0, -cost));
            m = e.size();
            g[from].add(m - 2);
            g[to].add(m - 1);
        }

        boolean bellman(int s, int t, int[] flow, int[] cost) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= t; i++) {
                d[i] = (int) inf;
                inq[i] = 0;
            }
            d[s] = 0;
            inq[s] = 1;
            p[s] = 0;
            a[s] = (int) inf;
            Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
            Q.add(s);

            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = Q.poll();
                inq[u] = 0;

                for (int i = 0; i < g[u].size(); i++) {
                    Edge ee = e.get(g[u].get(i));
                    if (ee.cap > ee.flow && d[ee.to] > d[u] + ee.cost) {
                        d[ee.to] = d[u] + ee.cost;
                        p[ee.to] = g[u].get(i);
                        a[ee.to] = Math.min(a[u], ee.cap - ee.flow);
                        if (inq[ee.to] == 0) {
                            Q.add(ee.to);
                            inq[ee.to] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (d[t] == inf) return false;
            flow[0] += a[t];
            cost[0] += d[t] * a[t];
            int u = t;
            while (u != s) {
                e.get(p[u]).flow += a[t];
                e.get(p[u] ^ 1).flow -= a[t];
                u = e.get(p[u]).from;
            }
            return true;
        }

        int minCost(int s, int t) {
            int[] flow = new int[1];
            int[] cost = new int[1];
            while (bellman(s, t, flow, cost));
            return cost[0];
        }
    }

    static int read() throws IOException {
        int X = 0, w = 0;
        char ch = (char) System.in.read();
        while (!Character.isDigit(ch)) {
            if (ch == '-') w = 1;
            ch = (char) System.in.read();
        }
        while (Character.isDigit(ch)) {
            X = (X << 3) + (X << 1) + (ch ^ 48);
            ch = (char) System.in.read();
        }
        return w == 1 ? -X : X;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long m = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(br.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(br.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(br.nextToken());

        int[] a = new int[k + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        }

        int startPoint = 0;
        int endPoint = (int) (n * 100 + 1);

        MCMF solve = new MCMF(endPoint);

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            solve.add(startPoint, 1 + (a[i] - 1) * 100, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                int p = (i - 1) * 100;
                solve.add(p + j, p + j + 1, Integer.MAX_VALUE, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; i++) {
            solve.add(i, endPoint, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                int p = (x - 1) * 100 + j;
                int pp = (y - 1) * 100 + j + 1;
                for (int l = 1; l <= 50; l++) {
                    solve.add(p, pp, 1, d * (l * l - (l - 1) * (l - 1)) + c);
                }
            }

            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                int p = (y - 1) * 100 + j;
                int pp = (x - 1) * 100 + j + 1;
                for (int l = 1; l <= 50; l++) {
                    solve.add(p, pp, 1, d * (l * l - (l - 1) * (l - 1)) + c);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(solve.minCost(startPoint, endPoint));
    }
}
